OnPlay.issue: The empty-pile early return, the two-tier filter and the prefer-then-fall-back structure are all faithful. C#'s obfuscated type tests decode as expected: `(uint)(type - 5) <= 1u` excludes the two type values above Power (Curse and Quest) == the sim's `card_type not in (CardType.CURSE, CardType.QUEST)`, and `(uint)(type - 1) <= 2u` is the Attack/Skill/Power preference == the sim's `preferred` list; `options = preferred or eligible` is exactly C#'s `(list3.Count == 0) ? list2 : list3`. TWO DIVERGENCES. (1) WRONG RNG STREAM: `Owner.RunState.Rng.CombatCardSelection.NextItem(items)` (HiddenGem.cs:53) vs the sim's `ctx.combat._rng.choice(options)` (colorless_skills.py:321), where `ctx.combat.combat_rng.card_selection` maps to `combat_card_selection` (combat_rng.py:21,55). Same mechanism and same verdict as card/anointed's OnPlay entry (rule 3); LIVE, and one of the 21 `shared-rng` cards. (2) THE ALREADY-REPLAYING FILTER IS TOO NARROW: C#'s third clause is `c.GetEnchantedReplayCount() < 1`, and `GetEnchantedReplayCount()` is `Enchantment?.EnchantPlayCount(BaseReplayCount) ?? BaseReplayCount` (CardModel.cs:1129-1132) -- note the null branch returns BASEREPLAYCOUNT, so a card that is already replaying for ANY reason is excluded, including one a previous Hidden Gem raised. The sim's `_has_replay_enchantment` (colorless_skills.py:324-329) only checks whether the enchantment id is `spiral` or `glam`, so it never looks at `base_replay_count` at all. Observable: play two Hidden Gems and the sim can stack both on the SAME draw-pile card (5 plays) where the game must pick two different ones. LIVE -- Hidden Gem is a ported Rare colorless Skill and nothing stops a second copy. Presentation, folded in: TriggerAnim (29) and `CardCmd.Preview` (57). REGRESSION TEST: `test/test_rng_tripwire.py:33` (`test_no_wrong_stream_draws_in_random_run`, 20 seeded full runs) is the standing gate for this whole family. It wraps `RunState.rng` and asserts ZERO in-combat draws on it; `CombatState` receives that same object as `self._rng` (run.py:1146-1148, combat.py:88), so a `ctx.combat._rng` draw taken from inside a card's `on_play` is recorded and fails the gate -- verified by playing this family's shape under a `Tripwire` and getting a hit at the `card.on_play` frame (combat.py:490). The gate is green today, so these 20 seeds never reach this card's draw; routing the site to the named `combat_rng` accessor is verified by keeping it green.

guards.what: the card raises `BaseReplayCount` on ANOTHER card rather than doing anything itself (HiddenGem.cs:56)
guards.rationale: `cardModel.BaseReplayCount += Replay` == `card.base_replay_count += self._replay`, and the sim's normal play path feeds that field into `modify_card_play_count` as `1 + card.base_replay_count` (combat.py:469-470), matching C#'s `GetEnchantedReplayCount() + 1` (CardModel.cs:2017). So Hidden Gem is the card-side SOURCE of gap G4's blast radius, and card/drum_of_battle -- which reads the hook with a bare 1 and so ignores `base_replay_count` -- is the one ported consumer that gets it wrong.
